questions.question: Are the figures real?
questions.answer: Yes: WDI, PWT 11.0, ICP 2021, all CC BY 4.0. Two WDI editions, 8 October 2026 and March 2024. Every figure shows its source, edition and DQR.

questions.question: Why these six economies?
questions.answer: They are enough to show the measurement problems that a production-level version would have to handle: PPPs and hours least certain for China and India; Ireland's multinational profits in the euro area; India's rebase (February 2026); hedonic US price indexes.

questions.question: Can I ask a follow-up?
questions.answer: No. Each question is answered on its own; rephrase it as a complete question.

questions.question: Why is the explanation often missing?
questions.answer: The explanation is written by a small language model on a laptop. Strict checks are used to drop any sentence not traced to a passage in the context. The figures above the explanation are calculated from the data and do not depend on the language model.
